nodes.text:
Union Health Ministry Update: No surge in respiratory illnesses, including HMPV, across India. 

States advised to enhance surveillance (ILI/SARI) and spread awareness on preventive measures like handwashing and cough etiquette. 

Public reassured: no cause for concern. https://t.co/AfecgsCDzL
